definitions.gloss: to hate, to dislike, to loathe
definitions.explanation: To have strong negative feelings toward something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{野菜|やさい}を{嫌|きら}う。
みんなに{嫌|きら}われるのがこわい。
examples.english: I'm afraid of being disliked by everyone.

examples.japanese: {理由|りゆう}もなく{人|ひと}を{嫌|きら}うのはよくない。
examples.english: It's not right to dislike people without reason.

notes:
{嫌|きら}う is a godan verb meaning to hate or dislike, the verb form of the na-adjective {嫌|きら}い.

CONJUGATION:
{嫌|きら}わない (neg), {嫌|きら}います (polite), {嫌|きら}って (te-form), {嫌|きら}った (past)

KEY FORMS:
- {嫌|きら}い: dislike (na-adjective) - more common in speech
- {嫌|きら}う: to dislike (verb) - sounds literary/formal
- {嫌|きら}われる: to be disliked (passive) - very common

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{嫌|きら}われる: to be disliked by ~
- 〜を{嫌|きら}う: to dislike ~
- {嫌|きら}われ{者|もの}: unpopular person

INTENSITY SCALE:
- {苦手|にがて}: not good with (mildest)
- {嫌|きら}い/{嫌|きら}う: dislike
- {大嫌|だいきら}い: hate
- {憎|にく}む: to hate (strongest)

RELATED:
- {避|さ}ける: to avoid
- {嫌|いや}: unpleasant, disagreeable
